facts.fact: ThisDay reports the Central Bank of Nigeria directed all fintech companies to return payments data hosted outside Nigeria and host it in Nigeria with effect from 1 January 2027; the report is dated 25 September 2026, and the date given is the compliance date.

ThisDay reports the Central Bank of Nigeria as the body that issued the payments data hosting directive to fintechs and that bank CIOs had been unable to get clarity from over the previous three months, as at the 24 September 2026 panel.

systems.country_label: CBN directive on hosting payments data in Nigeria
